Permission scope is expressed in the type: the injected deps are Omit<DiagnoseDeps, "writeFile">, so D05's own --export path fails closed with exit 4 and nothing in the command can write, mkdir or append; the namespace is discovered through an injectable hook and output is bounded to three lines plus the top five clusters with the counted remainder.
